title: Scenario
description: A team, a target and a rotation to simulate on the timeline (packages/engine/src/timeline.ts).

oneOf.description: Path of a build file, relative to the scenario file.

controlled.description: Operator controlled at the start (default: the first).

startEnergy.description: Ultimate energy at the start, per operator ID: a number or "full" (default 0).

startStacks.description: Kit stacks at the start, per operator ID and stack ID (default: the kit's initial value, else 0).

controlImmune.description: Control statuses don't freeze this enemy (bosses with the control-immune tag; the data has no list).

crit.description: expected: the crit zone at its average; rolled: each hit crits or not by a seeded roll (crit-triggered effects need it).

seed.description: Seed of the battle's random draws (rolled crits); default 1.

chance.description: Chance that a dash is a perfect dodge (1: a skilled player; less for a less skilled one; 0: dashes that never succeed).

dodge.description: The controlled operator dashes at every enemy attack on it (enemyActions); a perfect dodge ends its action, gives SP and slows the world, cooldowns excepted. Absent: no dodges.

enemyActions.description: What the enemy does (default nothing): attacks on the team and skill charges, at listed times or every n seconds. Times are on the enemy's clock: time stops and freezes delay what comes after them.

every.description: Or every n seconds, from `from` (default n) to the fight's end.

target.description: Whom an attack hits: controlled (default), team, or an operator ID.
